errors.evidence: The figure clearly shows Excitement at 14.1%, not 14.7%. The description incorrectly assigns 14.7% to Excitement, which is actually the value for Sadness.

The description does not mention the colors of each slice (light blue for Frustration, darker blue for Neutral, blue for Happiness, yellow for Anger, orange for Sadness, red for Excitement), which are important visual attributes of the pie chart.
The description does not mention the absence of a legend, which is noted in the reference description as a relevant visual feature.
